revisions.reason: Modal invocation transport prerequisite: forward data-only inputWitness attachment from the same blocking Worker RPC alongside existing waitEntry. No callback entry, guest execution, asynchronous completion, scheduler or lifetime change. guest-rpc samples the existing native 32xi64 witness on the actual CPU import stack, validates request tuple/stage/monotonic sequence, and supplies an immutable trailing attachment. Missing or malformed negotiated modal proofs refuse without consumer invocation. Browser kinds6/7 acceptance remains closed; no gameplay or modal ACK claim. Real native CPUWorker DialogBox entry/return and invalid attachment controls in run20261121-modal-invocation-transport. Broader invocation ownership remains pending. WorkerLink supplies its own endpoint identity separately from the attachment; broker requires exact endpoint and native process/thread agreement and sequences per endpoint to prevent slot reuse inheritance.
